name: @iob-exploring-monorepo/api-go-name-generator
description: Simple Go API that returns a random username and id

scripts.dev:lean: go tool wgo -xdir tmp go build -o ./tmp/server . :: ./tmp/server
scripts.dev:full: go tool wgo -xdir tmp go build -gcflags='all=-N -l' -o ./tmp/server . :: go tool dlv exec ./tmp/server --headless --listen=127.0.0.1:2345 --api-version=2 --accept-multiclient --continue
